# betterado_test_plan (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_test_plan" "example" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  name       = "Sprint 1 Test Plan"
  area_path  = "MyProject\\TeamA"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `area_path` (String)
- `end_date` (String)
- `iteration_path` (String)
- `start_date` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `root_suite_id` (String)
